en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

I can gather mana if I'm sleeping in 
the sun or under a heating blanket.

I guess I'll start gathering mana to 
prepare for my next magic show...

I'm not good at dancing...
I always just get dizzy.

If you want to dance that bad, you can 
go ahead and do it by yourself...

Really? I don't think there's anything 
special about this view...

If you're bored...I could put on 
a magic show for you, maybe?

How about it? When you think about 
being able to see my magic show...

Doesn't it make this view seem boring? 
You don't have to hide it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
